players.product: synthetic DNA, proteins, antibody libraries, and characterization data

quarterly_data.signal: XBRL segment revenue: NGS applications revenue was $61.8M for the quarter 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30, +11.8% YoY vs $55.3M. From fiscal 2026 Twist combines synthetic genes, oligo pools, DNA libraries and biopharma antibody-discovery services into DNA synthesis and protein solutions, and NGS tools were renamed NGS applications. By customer group, Therapeutics customers provided 34% of quarterly revenue (28% a year earlier) and Diagnostics 37% (40%).
quarterly_data.figure: NGS applications $61.8M (+11.8% YoY vs $55.3M); Therapeutics 34% of revenue vs 28%

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q margins and capacity: gross margin was 52.8% in the quarter versus 53.4% a year earlier, due to customer mix; for the nine months it rose to 52.1% from 50.5% on higher revenues and process-improvement savings, partially offset by investments for capacity expansion and automation. Commitments for capital expenditures were $12.2 million as of June 30, 2026. Under an agreement with Invenra, Twist pays Invenra royalties on gross sales from third-party license sales, and Invenra provides sales, marketing and technical support and may act as a subcontractor for biopharma services associated with the platform.
quarterly_data.figure: gross margin 52.8% (Q3) and 52.1% (nine months); capex commitments $12.2 million
